# Kenney Animated Characters Protagonists

Source: https://kenney.nl/assets/animated-characters-protagonists
Download: https://kenney.nl/media/pages/assets/animated-characters-protagonists/608191acc4-1774773108/kenney_animated-characters-protagonists.zip
License: CC0 1.0; original License.txt included.
Retrieved 2026-10-09.

Subset: Model/characterMedium.fbx, Skins/skaterMaleA.png (unmodified).
The desktop replay creates a separate seated illustration and headset marker.
It uses a uniform gray mannequin material rather than the included skater texture;
the source texture is retained for asset provenance but is not applied to the avatar.
Body pose is not measured full-body motion or participant appearance.
The left hand is posed as a resting fist on the lap; the right hand uses a fixed
curled grip and follows the recorded controller through arm IK. Finger poses and
the palm-to-handle attachment are illustrative, not recorded hand tracking.
The controller mesh is oriented to the recorded forward axis. Its display ray
starts at the model's emitter and ends at the recorded hit point; the saved ray
origin, controller pose and hit data are not modified.
The body and chair seat are shifted 12 cm backward relative to the fixed chair
base for controller clearance. In third person, the orange display line starts
on the headset face and connects to the analytical ray endpoint. Gaze analysis,
vicinity checks and first-person projection retain their recorded/corrected ray.
